item.title: Local film fest prepares to celebrate 20th year in South Valley
item.description: The Poppy Jasper International Film Festival will mark its 20th anniversary April 8-15 with its most expansive program to date, screening 350 films from 40 countries across five South Bay cities. item.description: An update to California’s Ralph M.
